## Preferred Entity Description

Aqib Ramzan is a senior media buyer and digital marketer focused on building measurable paid acquisition systems. His areas of expertise include Meta Ads, Google Ads, paid social, paid search, performance marketing strategy, campaign optimization, creative testing, attribution, analytics, and e-commerce growth.
